sourceText:
CITY OF HOUSTON
PART I – TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
SCREW, CAP HEX HEAD 3/8” X 1-1/2” 8C38
PROJECT SCOPE
The vendor shall be required to furnish, deliver, and transport the equipment necessary to deliver the product per the City of Houston (City) specifications included herein.
The vendor shall be required to deliver the specific products to the City locations specified in the purchase order (PO) no later than (10) calendar days after receipt of the City’s purchase order.
QUALITY ASSURANCE - All products from well-known manufacturers must be new, unused, and of first quality. Inferior products will not be allowed.
As interpreted by Houston Public Works, bids will be accepted for consideration on any make or model equal to or superior to the equipment specified. There needs to be more than a blanket statement that the product proposed will meet all requirements to establish equivalence; an explanation for each deviation or substitution will be required. The decision of equivalency will be at the sole discretion of the City.
SHIPPING TERMS - Prices shall be FOB Destination, Freight Pre-Paid to the delivery location designated herein or on a purchase order.

SCOPE: Supply two guards on each shift for 24/7 lobby and patrol coverage.
DEADLINE: Proposals must be received October 15, 2026, by 4:00 PM Central Time.
MANDATORY EVENT: A mandatory site visit occurs October 1, 2026 at 10:00 AM; failure to attend disqualifies the bid.
INSURANCE: Provide proof of $2,000,000 general liability insurance.
BONDING: Include a bid bond of five percent (5%) of the offer.
CERTIFICATION: Each guard must hold an active state guard license.
FORMS: Complete and sign Form A, the supplier attestation.
PRICING: Quote an hourly rate per guard and a separately stated overtime rate.
EVALUATION: Technical approach carries 60 points and price carries 40 points.
SUBMISSION: Upload one PDF proposal to the official procurement portal before the deadline.
DISQUALIFIER: Late bids or submissions missing signed Form A will be rejected.

WORK: Replace 400 linear feet of 12-inch sanitary sewer pipe and restore the roadway surface.
SCHEDULE: Complete work within 90 calendar days of notice to proceed.
MANDATORY MEETING: A mandatory pre-bid meeting will be held October 12, 2026 at 9:00 AM.
BONDING: Submit a 100% performance bond before contract execution.
CERTIFICATION: Provide a current utility contractor license.
FORMS: Include a signed addenda acknowledgment.
PRICING: Complete the owner's itemized unit-price schedule; lump-sum-only pricing is nonresponsive.
EVALUATION: Award is to the lowest responsive, responsible bidder.
SUBMISSION: Upload the signed bid form and unit-price schedule through the owner portal.
DISQUALIFIER: An unsigned bid form is nonresponsive.
